verdict.rationale: Devin's first-party docs describe an official Devin CLI ('Devin for Terminal'). It runs in the local environment for interactive coding from the command line. It has slash commands such as /model and /handoff to send tasks to cloud Devin, an Adaptive model router, and MCP server extensibility with a permission system. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, documented install/auth and non-interactive/scripted usage details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Running Devin for Terminal in your local environment for quick fixes, code exploration, and interactive coding right from the command line
using /handoff to send longer tasks to cloud Devin
MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets you connect external tool servers to Devin CLI
You can switch away from Adaptive to a specific model at any time with /model.
